agent_host.description: The host address of the machine running the agent. Often the same as the DB host.

agent_password.description: The password for the agent user.

agent_port.description: The port that the agent has open for Fivetran's connection. Default value is 4343.

agent_public_cert.description: The public certificate generated by the agent.

archive_log_format.description: Format for archive log file names

archive_log_path.description: Directory where archive logs are located

connection_type.description: Possible values: `Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

server_name.description: Server name. Used when authenticating with Windows Authentication.

tde_certificate.description: Certificate used to protect a database encryption key

tde_certificate_name.description: Name of the Certificate used to protect a database encryption key

tde_password.description: Password of the TDE private key

tde_private_key.description: Private key associated with the TDE certificate

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

update_method.description: (Optional) The incremental update method the connector will use. The possible values are `"TELEPORT"` or `"NATIVE_UPDATE"`. The type defaults to `"NATIVE_UPDATE"` if the value is set to `null` or not specified.

user.description: The user name.  For Azure Databases, the format must be `user@domain`.
